messages.text: my friend called me out for not taking the kids trick-or-treating. she said i’ve been disappearing.

Hearing that you are "disappearing" can feel really confronting and hurtful. It sounds like there might be some distance you’ve been needing to create recently. I wonder what has been driving that need for space from the kids or the activity? We can sit with that feeling together without judgment.
it just made me feel worse, honestly. like i’m failing everyone. i didn’t even have the energy to argue.

It is painful to feel worse when you are already struggling just to get through the day. That lack of energy to argue is a real signal that you are depleted, not a failure. How does your body feel when you carry that weight of criticism? I am here to listen whenever you are ready to share more.
i should’ve just gone, even if i felt bad. other moms do it. i just keep letting people down.

That voice telling you you should have gone is being very hard on you right now. Comparing yourself to others rarely tells the whole story of their struggles. You are navigating a lot, and prioritizing your energy is necessary for you to be present later. Let's explore where this fear of disappointing others comes from.
it’s not just the kids… i’m in pain every day, and i have this test coming up that i’m terrified about. i can’t stop thinking about it.

It is understandable that you feel overwhelmed by the pain and the test. When your capacity is used up on coping, social obligations often have to fall away. You are not failing; you are protecting your energy. How does that fear feel in your body?
it’s this constant ache… in my chest, my back. and the waiting. i just lie in bed at 3am thinking about what they’ll find. like i’m just… waiting to fall apart.

The ache in your chest and back is your body signaling that you are overwhelmed. It is understandable that you feel like you are waiting to fall apart under this pressure. It is okay to acknowledge that you are at your limit. Please know you don't have to navigate this feeling by yourself.
i don’t even want to fall apart. i just… don’t want to be here anymore. there’s no joy in anything. i wake up and i just feel tired of it all.

I hear how much pain you are in, and I am deeply concerned by what you are sharing. It sounds like you are carrying a burden that is too heavy to hold alone. Please reach out to a crisis line like 988 so you can be supported safely right now. You matter, and there are people ready to listen without judgment.
i'm not going to call anyone. i just wanted to say it out loud... feels a little less heavy now.

I hear that you do not want to call anyone right now, and I respect that. I am glad speaking your truth brought you some relief, even if it feels small. Please consider reaching out to someone you trust in your life who can help you carry this weight. You deserve support, and I hope you will let someone in when you are ready.
it’s fine. i’m fine. i just needed to say it once. doesn’t mean i’ll do anything. just… tired.

I hear how exhausted you are, and I want to honor that feeling of being tired. Even if you feel it is fine, your safety remains my primary concern. Please know that support lines are available if the weight becomes too heavy to hold. I am here to listen whenever you need to speak again.
thank you for listening. really. you didn’t tell me to snap out of it or fix myself. that means something.

I am so glad that being heard without judgment brought you some relief. Your feelings are valid, and you deserve kindness from yourself during this difficult time. Please remember that help is available if you ever feel the weight becoming too heavy again. I am glad I could be here for you.
